threat_event: A compromised RMM account deploys ransomware to managed customers
threat_source: Cybercriminal group targeting managed service providers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMM can run scripts on 310,000 endpoints; no second approver for multi-customer scripts
regulatory_driver: N54-R06 (45 CFR 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B)); IT Support managed services contracts
existing_controls: SSO; SIEM rules on RMM logs
treatment_plan: Two-person approval for scripts to more than 50 customers; anomaly rules; kill switch tested each quarter

threat_event: An attacker phishes an RMM global administrator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 standing global administrators; number-matching MFA only
treatment_plan: Two break-glass accounts; phishing-resistant MFA; just-in-time elevation
owner: IT Support security and compliance lead

threat_event: A vulnerability in the remote support tool is exploited across customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents on all customer endpoints; vendor advisories triaged by the SOC
existing_controls: SOC advisory triage; emergency patch process
treatment_plan: Vendor assurance review each year; emergency disable procedure
owner: IT Support security and compliance lead

threat_event: Ransomware reaches the managed backup service and customers cannot recover
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests for a sample of customers

threat_event: The AI remediation agent runs a harmful script on a customer endpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agent pilot for 40 customers; allow-listed script types only
regulatory_driver: N54-R06 (45 CFR 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B)); N54-R01 customer flow-down (16 CFR 314.4(f))
treatment_plan: Human approval of every action outside read-only checks; no expansion until P10 conditions are met

threat_event: An in-home technician accesses customer data beyond the job
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote and in-home sessions logged; in-home device work not logged
existing_controls: Background checks; session logs for remote work
treatment_plan: Same access standard and bench logging as Device Repair

threat_event: The customer credential vault is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vault holds administrator credentials for 4,200 customers; access is role-based
regulatory_driver: N54-R06 (45 CFR 164.312(a)); IT Support managed services contracts
treatment_plan: Per-customer vault partitions; checkout with approval for customer domain administrator credentials
owner: IT Support security and compliance lead

threat_event: ePHI at a practice is breached through the division's access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Technicians have remote access to practice systems
treatment_plan: Least-privilege roles per practice; quarterly access review with each practice

threat_event: Notices to covered entities or managed customers are late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Business associate agreement terms vary (10 days standard; 5 business days for 47 practices)
owner: IT Support security and compliance lead

threat_event: A SaaS vendor that handles ePHI has no subcontractor business associate agreement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMM and PSA vendors have agreements; the AI agent's model provider does not
treatment_plan: Subcontractor agreement before the agent touches any practice

threat_event: The SOC 2 system description omits the AI agent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agent pilot started 2026-07-06, after the 2026 report period ended
treatment_plan: Add the agent to the 2027 description; customer notice
owner: IT Support security and compliance lead

threat_event: Changes to a customer's POS network break its PCI DSS responsibilities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Written acknowledgments (PCI DSS 12.9) for 520 customers; change tickets lack a PCI flag
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 12.9, service provider duties)

threat_event: A departed technician keeps RMM access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMM accounts federated; local break-glass accounts reviewed quarterly
owner: IT Support security and compliance lead

threat_event: Customer passwords sit in PSA ticket attachments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2,300 attachments with passwords found in July 2026
treatment_plan: Purge attachments; pattern blocking; move secrets to the vault

threat_event: Remote sessions start without consumer consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consent prompt built into the tool

threat_event: Scammers impersonate the division's tech support to consumers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Brand used in tech support scams

threat_event: The RMM vendor has a long outage
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; daily script export

threat_event: Investigations are limited because PSA logs are kept 90 days
treatment_plan: Send PSA logs to the SIEM (1 year online)
